haddock.name: Captain Archibald Haddock
haddock.title: Master of the Karaboudjan
haddock.backstory: A retired Merchant Marine captain, Haddock inherited a cursed treasure and Marlinspike Hall. Despite his fiery temper and creative insults, he becomes Tintin's most steadfast friend and a truly courageous adventurer.

base_appearance.face: rugged, heavy‑jawed, with a thick black beard
base_appearance.hair: wild, dark, with a receding hairline

clothing.primary: blue knit sweater with an anchor emblem

visual_description.distinctive_marks: scar on his left cheek, pipe (when not smoking)
visual_description.mannerisms: gestures wildly, stomps, tugs at beard

deck_1.visual_changes: veins throbbing, eyes wild, gripping a belaying pin

deck_2.visual_changes: clear eyes, stern jaw, holding his pipe

deck_3.visual_changes: full captain's uniform, polished boots, standing tall

castafiore.name: Bianca Castafiore
castafiore.title: The Milanese Nightingale
castafiore.backstory: A world‑renowned opera diva, Castafiore is adored by audiences but dreaded by Haddock. Her booming voice and scatterbrained charm have saved the day more than once, often by accident.

base_appearance.face: round, heavily powdered, with thick eyelashes
base_appearance.eyes: large, expressive, often tearful during arias
base_appearance.hair: voluminous dark curls, often pinned up

clothing.primary: elaborate opera gown with fur stole

deck_1.visual_changes: full regalia, holding a jewel‑encrusted sceptre

deck_3.visual_changes: sweat and smudged makeup, clutching a broken fan

tintin.name: Tintin
tintin.title: The Boy Reporter
tintin.backstory: A young Belgian reporter whose curiosity drives him into one adventure after another. He solves international mysteries, fights villains, and always fights for what is right.

clothing.primary: blue shirt, white collar, brown plus‑fours

visual_description.distinctive_marks: no obvious marks – the everyman hero

snowy.name: Snowy (Milou)
snowy.title: Tintin's Faithful Wire Fox Terrier
snowy.backstory: Tintin's constant four‑legged companion. Snowy often provides sarcastic internal commentary and has a weakness for treats and adventure. His sharp nose and courage have saved Tintin countless times.

calculus.name: Professor Cuthbert Calculus
calculus.title: The Eccentric Physicist
calculus.backstory: A half‑deaf physicist who invents devices like the shark submarine and moon rocket. Despite his genius, he misinterprets conversations, leading to hilarious misunderstandings, but his heart is pure.

base_appearance.face: wrinkled, with a large bald dome and fringe
base_appearance.hair: scraggly white sideburns and a thin fringe

clothing.details: worn lapels, a pin for his Legion of Honour

visual_description.mannerisms: cups ear, bobs head, pulls at collar

deck_1.visual_changes: holding plans, pocket full of pencils

deck_2.visual_changes: frizzy hair, torn jacket, red face
